topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students, introduces the scope of the lecture series, and outlines the specific learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Multistep Failure of Cellular Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the accumulation of genetic and epigenetic alterations causes cells to deviate from normal developmental and tissue differentiation programs.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and the Progression to Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the histological, physical, and stepwise biological processes through which localized benign tumors breach basement membranes and spread to distant sites.

topics.label: Principles of Tumor Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and exceptions used to name benign and malignant neoplasms based on their tissue origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the local physical obstructions, systemic metabolic disruptions, and organ failures through which tumors cause disease and death.

topics.label: Patterns of Cancer Incidence Across Human Tissues and Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological data on tumor prevalence in humans and compare tumor distribution across different animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical Rationale and Methods for Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the principles, clinical efficacy, and limitations of early screening approaches across different anatomical cancer sites.

topics.label: Closing Framing and Practical Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by reiterating the learning outcomes and providing information on upcoming practicals and lectures.
